newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer PZU in talks with some 10 investors.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer PZU in talks with some 10 investors.

text.p: Poland's largest insurance company, state-owned Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU), is in talks with about 10 investors about taking a stake in the company, the firm's spokesman said on Monday.

Marek Maszek said PZU wanted to sign agreements with the investors, who are expected to buy shares worth between 500 and 600 million zlotys, or up to 50 percent of the insurer, in late June or early July. @
